panels.flag: NOT COMPARABLE — Zoho has no change history on this page
text: Zoho records the change in Setup → Audit Log with the user who made it.
TAVI's API already returns changed_by for each row (GET /settings/history), so only the screen is missing it.

notes: The rows on 21 Oct 2026 are the QA run's own switches; each was set back to Role-based.
